description: Aider-polyglot style (TypeScript): implement an interval index with closed intervals from a stub and an instructions file - touching intervals overlap, zero-length intervals, code-unit id ordering as a tiebreak, identical bounds with different ids, duplicate-id rejection, defensive copies, plus a seeded random cross-check against a brute-force model. The unit tests are the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs them, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
